chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abd Allah ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'When the sun declines on the day of Friday, so begin with the Obligatory (prayers).'
ai.seo_question: When should the Friday prayer begin according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies that the Friday congregational prayer begins precisely at Zawal (the sun's zenith), aligning it with the onset of the Dhuhr prayer time. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the validity of performing Jumu'ah as a distinct obligation that supersedes the four-rak'ah Dhuhr prayer when performed in congregation, emphasizing the temporal precedence of the call to prayer. The instruction to 'begin with' the written (obligatory) prayer highlights the priority of the congregational act over individual recitation.
